basic_details.job_title: DRDO TBRL Paid Internship Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 43 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Terminal Ballistics Research Laboratory (TBRL), Defence Research and Development Organization, Ministry of Defence, has invited applications for 43 paid internships of six months (January 2027 – June 2027) in 12 branch codes: 10 for under-graduate engineering students (38 places) and 2 for second-year M.Sc. students (5 places). Applications are sent by post to The Director, TBRL, Sector-30, Chandigarh - 160030, and the last date of receipt is 13 November 2026. Applications received after the due date will be rejected.

Post, to the address given below

content_sections.heading: About TBRL
content_sections.text: Terminal Ballistics Research Laboratory (TBRL) describes itself as a premiere research laboratory under DRDO, Ministry of Defence, Government of India. It is located at Sector-30, Chandigarh. The internships are offered under the internship scheme introduced by the Government of India, and the interns work at TBRL, Range Ramgarh, District: Panchkula, Haryana.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Students must apply in the prescribed form only. The application form is printed in the notice and can also be downloaded from the DRDO website, https://drdo.gov.in . The notice does not name the postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand). Address: The Director, Terminal Ballistics Research Laboratory, Defence Research and Development Organization, Government of India, Ministry of Defence, Sector-30, Chandigarh - 160030. Kind Attention: To HRD Division.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The 43 internships are divided into two categories. The stipend is the same for every branch code: Rs. 5,000/- per month for 6 months, at TBRL, Range Ramgarh, District: Panchkula, Haryana. The notice states that the 43 vacancies in both categories (a) and (b) together may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of the Establishment. If suitable candidates are not available in one branch, the vacancies may be adjusted or transferred to other disciplines. No equivalent qualification or related branch will be considered. Under-Graduate Internship (AER, CHE, CIE, CSE, ECE, ELE, IT, INE, MEE, MSM): students pursuing B.E. / B.Tech. / B.Sc. (Four Year Course) in the respective discipline, full-time, from a recognized Indian college / institute / university. The category heading says sixth semester onwards, and the internship must be part of the degree course. Post-Graduate Internship (CHS, PHY): students in the second year of M.Sc. in the respective discipline, full-time, from a recognized Indian college / institute / university. The internship must be part of the degree course. Marks: 75% or above (CGPA to be converted to percentage in the application format by the college / university), from an AICTE / UGC approved college / university. Students with backlogs are not eligible. Applicants must be Indian citizens. The notice says engineering students studying in the third / final year of B.E. / B.Tech. / B.Sc. (Four years degree course), and science students in the second year of M.Sc., in the academic year 2027-2028 can apply. The age of the student should be less than 28 years (as on 31 December 2026). The notice prints no age relaxation. Applicants should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Terms of the Internship
content_sections.text: Duration: 6 months, starting from 1 January 2027 tentatively. Stipend: Rs. 5,000/- per month, a total of Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only), paid in two equal instalments of Rs. 15,000/- after 3 months and Rs. 15,000/- after 6 months, subject to attendance of a minimum of 15 days in a month. It is paid directly to the student's bank account. The student must submit a progress report after 3 months and a project report after 6 months / completion of the training. TBRL will issue the internship completion certificate after successful completion, which includes clearing evaluation of project work, submitting the project report and completing other formalities. A student who leaves midway or does not complete the 6 months receives no completion certificate and no payment. No accommodation or transport is provided. Lodging, boarding, transport, medical and other costs are borne by the student. Working hours are as per the Laboratory / Establishment time. No leave except sick leave, with a valid prescription, is given.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents named in the application form checklist, to be sent with the application: The application form also asks for a latest passport size photograph on the form, the average percentage of marks of all semesters / years completed, and achievements, if any. TPO letter for the six-month training duration, from the intimated date of start Bonafide and Character Certificate from the college No Objection Certificate (NOC) from college authorities, in original, on college letterhead, stating that the student will be relieved for six months and will be present for a minimum of 15 working days in a month Police verification from hometown / place of residence, with the acknowledgement received from the police station Undertakings for adherence to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 and to the IT Rules and Regulations applicable for the Ministry of Defence Bank details for transfer of stipend Aadhar Card in original with college ID card, and 3 passport size photographs All previous semesters' mark sheets in original, or a letter from the college certifying that the original certificates are held with it Indemnity Form, to be provided by the college / university as and when required by TBRL Original documents will be returned immediately after verification. Any other documents required will be communicated at the time of selection / joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on merit and suitability, through shortlisting of applications, an online / telephonic interview or interaction as required, and verification of documents. Shortlisting: the selection is based on merit / suitability of the candidate for the project / assignment / any other selection criteria decided by the Laboratory, based on cumulative marks percentage / CGPA obtained up to the last semester / year, or the profile of the candidate. Candidates are shortlisted as per the vacancies indicated. Interview: an online / telephonic interview / interaction is held as required. Verification: selection is subject to satisfactory verification of the documents. Tie: if two candidates obtain the same percentage of marks, the candidate older in age is preferred on Date of Birth. Intimation: selected students are told about the joining procedure only through official e-mail to the e-mail ID given in the application form, with the terms, conditions and guidelines of the internship. No communication is made with unselected students. After selection, the candidate must obtain a police verification certificate and submit it at joining.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TBRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 43 paid internship vacancies: 38 for under-graduate engineering students and 5 for post-graduate M.Sc. students. The notice calls the number tentative, and it may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the TBRL paid internship?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of applications is 13 November 2026. Applications received after the due date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the TBRL internship?
faq.answer: Students must be pursuing a full-time B.E. / B.Tech. / B.Sc. (Four Year Course) or second-year M.Sc. in the respective discipline, with 75% or above marks from an AICTE / UGC approved college / university. Students with backlogs are not eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The student must be less than 28 years of age as on 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 5,000/- per month, a total of Rs. 30,000/-, paid in two instalments of Rs. 15,000/- after 3 and 6 months. It requires a minimum attendance of 15 days in a month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the TBRL internship?
faq.answer: Send the filled prescribed application form, the college request letter and the enclosures by post to The Director, TBRL, Sector-30, Chandigarh - 160030, Kind Attention: To HRD Division. Write "Application for Paid Internship: Starting January 2027" and the Branch Code on the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. How are interns selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on merit, based on cumulative marks percentage / CGPA up to the last semester / year or the candidate's profile, with an online / telephonic interview / interaction as required, and document verification. Selected students are told by official e-mail.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the internship be held?
faq.answer: All interns report at TBRL, Range Ramgarh, District: Panchkula, Haryana. The notice says no accommodation or transport is provided.

faq.question: Q9. Does the internship lead to a job at DRDO?
faq.answer: No. TBRL / DRDO has no obligation to offer employment, and an intern cannot claim any right to employment on completing the internship.

faq.question: Q10. When will the internship start?
faq.answer: The internship is tentatively planned to start on 1 January 2027 for 6 months. Selected students are to be informed in the first or second week of December 2026.
